product.ta-100-2.summary: The TA 100/2 added a separate numeric keypad for accounting work.
product.ta-100-2.history: The /2 was the accounting model in the TA 100 range, between the /1 invoicing machine and the /3 for magnetic ledger cards. Rainer Horniger’s archive dates it to 1972. Computeum documents a unit from the Computermuseum in Stuttgart.
product.ta-100-2.technical.configuration: The operator could enter amounts on a separate keypad. Triumph-Adler’s photographs show the typewriter, the numeric keypad and the electronics cabinet.
product.ta-100-2.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-100-2.technical.limitations: The board and the contents of program memory remain to be documented on an identified unit.
